subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Redwood — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Redwood — next steps

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we’re aligned on next steps and decision timeline. I’ve attached a one-page MAP template (Redwood_MAP_Template_v2.xlsx) — I’ll update it based on any feedback below.

Key pain points you shared:
- High per-request latency on embedding/semantic search workloads causing slower UX for knowledge search (avg 1.8s p90).
- Rising token costs due to redundant calls and lack of prefix cache reuse.
- SOC 2 + data residency requirements for EU customer subsets.

Goals / success criteria:
1) Reduce p90 latency to <1.0s for semantic search flows.
2) Cut per-token inference spend by ~30% through batching + caching.
3) Achieve a compliant deployment plan for EU-regulated data (VPC + KMS).

Proposed MAP (initial milestones):
- Week 1 (by 2026-11-17): Technical deep-dive with ACME infra + Redwood infra team to capture existing traffic patterns & dataset samples. (Owners: ACME: Samir; Redwood: Rishi)
- Week 2 (by 2026-11-24): Proof-of-concept: run production-like inference on Redwood Dedicated with representative sample, measure latency/cost delta. (Owners: ACME: Elena; Redwood: Marissa)
- Week 4 (by 2026-12-08): Security/compliance review — share SOC2 artifacts and KMS onboarding plan. (Owners: ACME: Security lead TBD; Redwood: Rishi)
- Week 6 (by 2026-12-22): Executive sign-off & contract review for Dedicated capacity commit. (Owners: ACME: Procurement; Redwood: Marissa)

Decision process / stakeholders:
- Technical evaluation: Elena (Search Lead) + ACME infra engineers
- Security & compliance: ACME Security team (samir to confirm rep)
- Procurement & legal: Procure/Legal (final contract owners)

Ask / immediate next steps:
1) Confirm internal stakeholder list and availability for the Week 1 deep-dive (proposed: 2026-11-16 or 11-17).
2) Share a small sample of traffic characteristics (query length distribution, average requests/sec) — can be redacted.
3) Please review the attached MAP template; I’ll update with confirmed dates after your confirmation.

If that looks good I’ll block time on both calendars for the deep-dive and upload the updated MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to working through this with you.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from my side:

- Week 1 deep-dive: 11/17 works best for us; I’ll invite our infra leads (Amit Shah, Priya Reddy) and include a short agenda focused on traffic profile + test dataset.
- For the security/compliance milestone, our security lead will be Priya Reddy — I’ll confirm if she prefers a pre-call to align on documents.
- Regarding the POC measurement, can you confirm whether the POC will be run against Dedicated or Hosted with a logging hook? We want realistic perf numbers.

I’ll upload a redacted traffic sample to the shared folder by EOD tomorrow.

Samir
VP, Product — ACME Corporation
samir.patel@acme.com | +1 (650) 555-6622

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Redwood — next steps

Hi all —

Quick answers to Samir’s questions:
- POC plan: we recommend running the POC on Redwood Dedicated to capture tail latency and batch behavior. We can mirror your production traffic shape; if Dedicated isn’t available in time we’ll run against Hosted with tracing enabled and call that out in the report.
- For the security artifacts: I’ll share our SOC 2 summary and the KMS onboarding checklist before the Week 2 milestone.
- Pricing note for procurement: baseline estimate for a 3-month Dedicated pilot is attached in the MAP template (sheet: pricing-estimate). We can refine after we see your traffic sample.

Action: I’ll prepare the infra checklist and sample test harness by 11/16 so the deep-dive can be focused and hands-on.

—

Samir / Elena —

Thanks — I’ve updated the attached MAP with the confirmed deep-dive on 2026-11-17 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Attached file: Redwood_MAP_Template_v2.xlsx (updated). Highlights:
- Confirmed owners for Week 1: ACME infra (Amit Shah, Priya Reddy) + Redwood infra (Rishi + infra engineer).
- Added a quick test plan for the POC (data subsets, success metrics, acceptance criteria).
- Noted security deliverables with expected delivery 11/24.

Next steps for us:
1) ACME to share redacted traffic sample by 11/11 EOD (Samir mentioned EOD tomorrow).
2) Redwood to provide test harness + SOC2 summary by 11/16 (Rishi).
3) Run POC window 11/18–11/22 and share measurement report by 11/24.

Lauren (cc’d) will own the contract timeline & procurement check-ins from Redwood side — looping her in so procurement conversations can start in parallel.

Thanks — I’ll attach a version of the MAP to the calendar event so everyone has the doc.

Best,
